description: Strip inherited OPEN_TERMINAL_* credentials from shells, execution and notebook kernels; preserve application environment.

description: Do not pass host/port to FastMCP stdio transport.
source: Minimal transport fix discussed in PR #120; HTTP authentication changes not imported.

description: Pin shared API/runtime dependencies to the tested Open WebUI-compatible versions; avoid upgrading its FastAPI/Pydantic during Terminal installation.
Bound grep match previews to prevent LLM context flooding; preserve long JSON/minified-code matches and center the preview on the match. Do not silently skip long lines.
source: Adapted from the problem and output cap in upstream PR #144; long-line matching is retained.

description: Avoid copying a whole multi-megabyte line when building a bounded grep preview; preserve exact Unicode/trailing-EOL output. CPU measurements use the real grep API.
Upstream0.14.7 file-creation dates; pypdf6.21.4 security update. Existing delivery/grep/MCP fixes retained.
verification: Targeted regressions plus exact-source package/privacy/security/startup gates; final CI receipt records actual scope.

description: PR150 adapted to streamed log responses: keep unread completed results30min, start5min expiry only after HTTP response completion; protect all retained process logs from the existing disk sweep. Existing orphan-log cleanup already covers PR149; configurable keep-alive already exists.
verification: Actual cleanup/response helper regressions: unread/running/expired records, completed delivery and preserved response cleanup.

description: PR193 CORS precedence: honor TOML without overriding explicit CLI/env origins; reject invalid config types. PR116 narrow adaptation: add MCP --api-key override before deferred env load; reuse existing env/TOML/_FILE resolution and preserve stdio/HTTP guards.
verification: 12 CORS and12 MCP CLI scenarios with synthetic TOML/env/file sources; build recipe runs both regressions. No auth guard or API-key storage changes.

description: Merge official main6444534: owned browser/Chrome/desktop APIs, bounded frames, fs/port/process WebSockets and Git endpoints. Preserve CORS/MCP CLI fixes, common dependency pins, bounded grep and delivery-aware log retention. Restart a completed shared port scanner for new viewers; use shared constant-time API-key matching for MCP.
verification: 15 new isolated API/log/port/frame/MCP/CDP cases;12 CORS and12 MCP CLI scenarios;5 existing behavior and3 retention tests. No real browser/screen/input/audio action and no complete hardware or packaged startup proof.
dependency_scope: watchfiles1.3.0/websockets15.0.1/Pillow13.0.0 match the tested shared runtime. New host capture dependencies remain upstream constraints, pending fresh package audit/qualification; vendor wheels are not declared locally rebuilt.
privacy: Windows Chrome uses a dedicated managed profile and loopback CDP with proxy=None, without inherited OPEN_TERMINAL_* credentials. Browser proxy strips API-key/cookie/x-user request headers.
license_scope: Accepted from immutable official Open Terminal MIT source; original copyright and Computer-origin attribution header retained. No Computer binary/service imported.

description: PR192 adapted: read regular files only, skip pseudo-filesystem roots in rg, stay on the search root filesystem and exclude dev/proc/sys when scanning filesystem root. Explicitly selected mounts remain searchable; existing ACL checks retained.
verification: 6 isolated stat/mount/ACL/rg guard regressions; Linux device files not opened on the Windows host.

description: Select independent PR178 fixes: original-text case-insensitive matching preserves Unicode/UTF16 columns; enforce the existing1MiB content-search cap with or without ripgrep. Reuse the existing bounded match preview for match_files, retaining discoverability, original column and an explicit excerpt_truncated flag.
verification: 4 actual HTTP-route tests cover Unicode/UTF16 on both fake-RG and fallback paths, size gating and long-line preview. Immutable PR review has6 independent repros in maintenance. No real RG/capture/vendor request claim.
not_imported: Broad response-byte budgets: first oversized item/log record is retained above the configured budget, escaped display paths and post-fit cursor metadata can overrun the cap. Existing streaming complete-file/log behavior remains; no claim of globally bounded model-facing output. Issue177 follow-up remains open.
